title: PowerShell Web Download Cradle Via Script Block Logging
description:
Detects PowerShell download cradles in Script Block Logging (EID 4104) that combine a
network-download primitive (Net.WebClient / DownloadFile / DownloadString / Invoke-WebRequest)
with an execution or in-memory follow-on (Invoke-Item, Invoke-Expression/IEX, Start-Process,
or a TLS SecurityProtocol pin). This is a common first-stage malware pattern (e.g. Emotet
downloaders). Sigma string matching is case-insensitive by default, so heavily mixed-case /
concatenation-obfuscated variants are matched without enumerating every casing.
sigma: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Net.WebClient%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadString(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadData(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-BitsTransfer%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-Item%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-Expression%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IEX %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IEX(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-Process%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Net.ServicePointManager%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\')))
